title.en: Seismic Waves Probing the Earth’s Core

description.zh: P 波快、S 波慢，用 S−P 时间估震中距并用三个台站画圆定位；用球对称速度分层追踪射线，看波线向上弯曲、P 波影区与 S 波被液态外核挡住；再看震级与能量的对数关系。教学用的粗略一维模型，影区角度与真实地球不同。
description.en: P is fast and S slow: estimate the epicentre distance from S−P and locate it with three stations’ circles; trace rays through a spherically symmetric layered speed model to see rays curve upward, the P shadow zone and S waves blocked by the liquid outer core; then the logarithmic magnitude–energy relation. A coarse one-dimensional teaching model whose shadow-zone angles differ from the real Earth.

label.zh: 波线在速度变化处折射

reason.zh: 第 2 步用球层中守恒的射线参数 p = r sinθ/v（折射定律的球对称形式）追踪地震波线。
reason.en: Step 2 traces seismic rays with the ray parameter p = r sinθ/v conserved in a sphere, the spherical form of Snell’s law.

label.zh: 地震图是多种波的叠加
label.en: A seismogram is a sum of several waves

reason.zh: 第 0 步的地震图由背景噪声、P 波与 S 波叠加而成，读图就是识别叠加中各个到达时刻。
reason.en: Step 0’s seismogram is background noise plus a P wave plus an S wave, and reading it means picking out each arrival in the sum.

title.zh: 没人到过地核，怎么知道它是液体？
title.en: No one has been to the core, so how do we know it is liquid?

ask.zh: P 波快、S 波慢——用 S−P 时间能估出震中距，为什么还需要三个台站才能定位？
ask.en: P is fast and S is slow — S−P time estimates the epicentre distance, so why do you need three stations to locate it?

ask.zh: S 波被液态外核挡住——如果外核是固态，S 波会怎样？P 波影区又说明什么？
ask.en: S waves are blocked by the liquid outer core — if it were solid, what would S waves do? And what does the P-wave shadow zone tell us?

reveal.zh: S 波穿不过液态外核、P 波有影区，波线弯曲和影区位置合起来说明外核是液体；没人下去也能从波里读出地球内部。
reveal.en: S waves cannot cross a liquid outer core and P waves leave a shadow zone; the bending rays and shadow pattern together say the outer core is liquid — Earth's interior read from waves alone.
